1. (Currently amended): A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __that is not accessible through the path without the radial expansion__.

2. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic intervention__.

3. (Original)

4. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device is positioned between non-adjacent tissue layers within the brain__.

5. (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __in a manner that creates a working channel of sufficient size to accommodate passage of the medical element without additional expansion__.

6. (Original)

7. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __by maintaining the radial expansion__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that requires the maintained radial reinforcement__.

8. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic intervention requiring the maintained working channel__.

9. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel to tissue displaced by the radial expansion__.

10. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the radial expansion creates a working channel between the tissue layers__.

11. (Original)

12. (Currently amended): The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __from the displaced tissue__.

13. (Currently amended): A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent __while maintaining the second expandable body in radial expansion__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that requires access through the stent-reinforced working channel__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a therapeutic intervention through the stent-reinforced working channel__.

15. (Original)

16. (Currently amended): The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __such that the radial expansion of the second expandable body creates a working channel between the tissue layers__.

17. (Original)
